job_id, tenant_id, owner_id, document_id, document_version, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, source_bucket, source_key, content_hash, content_type, size_bytes, status, stage, error_code, retryable, retry_count, revision, created_at, updated_at, preparation_schema, processor_version, parser_profile, index_generation
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND idempotency_key = #{key} AND command_scope = 'CREATE'

SELECT d.document_id, d.version AS content_revision, j.job_id, j.status, (d.published_version = d.version AND d.published_generation IS NOT NULL AND d.published_job_id IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE AS is_published FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND j.owner_id = d.owner_id AND j.document_id = d.document_id AND j.job_id = d.ingestion_job_id AND j.document_version = d.version AND j.content_hash = d.content_hash WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND d.active_content_hash = #{hash} AND d.lifecycle = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND job_id = #{id}

SELECT j.job_id,j.tenant_id,j.owner_id,j.document_id,j.document_version,j.idempotency_key, j.request_fingerprint,j.source_bucket,j.source_key,j.content_hash,j.content_type,j.size_bytes, j.status,j.stage,j.error_code,(j.retryable AND d.active_job_id=j.job_id) AS retryable, j.retry_count,j.revision,j.created_at,j.updated_at,j.preparation_schema,j.processor_version, j.parser_profile,j.index_generation FROM knowledge_ingestion j JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND d.owner_id=j.owner_id AND d.document_id=j.document_id WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND j.job_id=#{id} AND d.lifecycle='ACTIVE'
